segments.text: Hello, everyone. Thank you guys for coming to our weekly student success meeting.
segments.label: REAL

segments.speaker: Speaker_1
segments.text: And let's just get started. So I have our list of chronically absent students here. And I've been noticing a troubling trend. A lot of students are skipping on Fridays. Does anyone have any idea what's going on?
segments.label: REAL

segments.speaker: Speaker_2
segments.text: I've heard some of my mentees talking about how it's really hard to get out of bed on Fridays.
segments.label: REAL

segments.speaker: Speaker_2
segments.text: It might be good if we did something like a pancake breakfast to encourage them to come.
segments.label: REAL

segments.speaker: Speaker_1
segments.text: I think that's a great idea.
segments.label: SPOOF

segments.speaker: Speaker_3
segments.text: It might also be because a lot of students have been getting sick now that it's getting colder outside. I've had a number of students come by my office with symptoms like sniffling and coughing. We should put up posters with tips for not getting sick since it's almost flu season, like, you know, wash your hands after the bathroom, stuff like that.
segments.label: REAL

segments.speaker: Speaker_1
segments.text: I think that's a good idea and it'll be a good reminder for the teachers as well. So one other thing I wanted to talk about, there's a student I've noticed here, John Smith.

segments.text: He's missed seven days already and it's only November. Does anyone have an idea what's going on with him?
